subject: Web Development
title: Streaming and Partial Rendering
description: A 60-second lesson on Streaming and Partial Rendering.

hook.text: Traditional servers wait until the entire page is ready before sending anything.

buildup.text: Streaming sends HTML in chunks as soon as each piece is ready.

discovery.text: Users see the header and navigation instantly while slower data loads in the background.

twist.text: React Server Components and Next.js leverage streaming natively for faster perceived loads.

climax.text: Streaming turns loading from an all-or-nothing event into a gradual reveal.

punchline.text: Send what you have; don't wait for the rest.
